about.title: Unifying Multi-Modal Earth Data
about.paragraph1: Harvest Global SSP Pvt Ltd (HG Systems) pioneering Earth Intelligence integrates satellite imagery, climate and weather data, ground observations and geospatial intelligence into an enterprise-grade GeoAI stack, enabling governments and industries to move from fragmented data to predictive, actionable intelligence.
about.paragraph2: We build Geofoundational AI models and sovereign cloud infrastructure empowering governments, insurance providers, and global enterprises to address climate resilience, agriculture risk, and spatial governance.

title: From Earth Data to
Earth Intelligence
technology.description: Our Unified GeoAI Stack combines data infrastructure, foundation models, GeoAnalytics, AI compute and edge intelligence to move from observation to prediction and decision support.

stages.label: STAGE 01
stages.title: L0 Multi-Sensor Ingestion
stages.description: Continuous streams of optical, SAR, thermal, and meteorological Earth Observation data from satellites, sensors, and ground networks.

stages.label: STAGE 02
stages.title: Geo Foundation Models
stages.description: Proprietary GeoFM models and domain-specific AI for agriculture, forestry, hydrology, land-use and land-cover mapping, change detection, and other Earth applications.

stages.label: STAGE 03
stages.title: Sovereign Private Cloud
stages.description: Isolated, privacy-compliant AI compute clusters ensuring localized processing for strategic and sovereign datasets.

stages.label: STAGE 04
stages.title: Edge Ground-Station Processing
stages.description: On-demand Earth Observation AI at satellites, ground stations and edge nodes, reducing dependence on cloud latency.

stages.label: STAGE 05
stages.title: Downstream Risk & Yield Engines
stages.description: GeoAnalytics and decision-support solutions across agriculture, crop insurance, climate resilience, water security and infrastructure.

infrastructureNote.description: Built for scale with strict tech sovereignty, high availability, and institutional-grade data privacy.

title: Specialized GeoAI Solutions
Across Global Sectors.
applications.description: Empowering critical industries with sovereign, high-resolution spatio-temporal intelligence.

items.label: Agriculture
items.alt: Precision farming, crop monitoring, yield forecasting
items.description: AI-powered intelligence across the agricultural lifecycle — crop planning, crop monitoring, yield estimation, NPK intelligence, harvest monitoring, crop insurance and agri-credit.

items.label: Insurance
items.alt: Smart risk assessment, fraud detection, loss estimation
items.description: Making risk measurable — GeoAI transforms spatial and environmental data into actionable intelligence for insurance and risk assessment: crop insurance, damage assessment, risk analytics, yield estimation and farm credit.

items.label: Climate Intelligence
items.alt: Floods, droughts, wildfires, and extreme event modeling
items.description: Understanding a changing planet — climate modelling, environmental monitoring and spatial risk intelligence to identify changing patterns and support resilient decision-making.

items.label: Water Security
items.description: Surface water reservoir mapping, watershed monitoring, groundwater quality tracking, and flood response modeling.

items.label: Urban Planning
items.alt: Asset monitoring, smart cities, land use & change detection
items.description: Intelligence for cities that are constantly changing — spatial intelligence for understanding urban growth, infrastructure, land use and climate vulnerability.

items.label: Forestry
items.description: Monitoring forests at scale — GeoAI-powered intelligence for understanding forest change, land-use dynamics and environmental conditions.
